name: Salmon River valley forage field (Shuswap, BC)
county_code_system: Statistics Canada SGC census division (59 = BC)

source.title: ParcelMap BC legal parcel (open parcel fabric) inside the Agricultural Land Reserve, clipped to AAFC Annual Crop Inventory Pasture / Forages pixels (class 122 in >= 9 of 11 mapped years)

area_ha.note: polygon area of the ParcelMap BC x AAFC ACI outline chosen by backend/bc

farmer_name: Hay field in the Salmon River valley, 10 km southwest of downtown Salmon Arm
why_chosen: BC example: the lower Salmon River was under the 16 Aug 2023 fish population protection order that stopped about 398 licence holders irrigating forage. AAFC classes this outline Pasture / Forages in every mapped year 2014-2025. Built on non-reserve farmland (6.5 km from the nearest reserve); see docs/bc-first-nations.md.

soil.muname: SLC v3.2 polygon 1004019: Bolean 30%; Rumball 30%; Nisconlith 20%; Hupel 10%; Lumby 10% (1:1,000,000 soil landscape, not a field-scale map unit)

source.title: AAFC Soil Landscapes of Canada v3.2 (1:1,000,000) with the Soil Name and Soil Layer tables v2

awc_mm_per_m.note: 0-100 cm water held between 33 and 1500 kPa (SLC layer table, % of soil volume), weighted by each soil's share of the polygon; low/high = the soils in the polygon that hold the least and the most water

source.title: AAFC Soil Landscapes of Canada v3.2 (1:1,000,000) with the Soil Name and Soil Layer tables v2

om_pct.note: 0-100 cm depth-weighted organic carbon x 1.724 (van Bemmelen factor, assumed), weighted by each soil's share; low/high = lowest and highest soil

texture_detail.method: USDA triangle on 0-100 cm sand/silt/clay, weighted by each soil's share of the SLC polygon

soil.hydrologic_group_method: derived: NRCS NEH 630 ch. 7 Table 7-1 on SLC Ksat, water-table depth assumed from the drainage class; dominant condition (largest share of the polygon)
soil.note: AAFC Soil Landscapes of Canada v3.2, a 1:1,000,000 map: the field lies in polygon 1004019 (39.8 km2), a mix of soils whose positions are not mapped. Values are weighted by each soil's share; drainage and hydrologic group are the class with the largest share. A soil test or the BC 1:20,000 soil survey map is the field-scale answer.

source.title: NASADEM HGT v001 (NASA JPL/LP DAAC), via Microsoft Planetary Computer

slope_mean_pct.note: Headline value is from a 5x5 (150 m) mean DEM because raw NASADEM pixels over flat farmland carry +-2-4 m radar noise; raw-pixel value is in slope_*_raw.

source.title: NASADEM HGT v001 (NASA JPL/LP DAAC), via Microsoft Planetary Computer

slope_p90_pct.note: Headline value is from a 5x5 (150 m) mean DEM because raw NASADEM pixels over flat farmland carry +-2-4 m radar noise; raw-pixel value is in slope_*_raw.

source.title: NASADEM HGT v001 (NASA JPL/LP DAAC), via Microsoft Planetary Computer

elev_m.note: NASADEM is a surface model (SRTM radar), vertical error several metres; use relative values.

source.title: NASADEM HGT v001 (NASA JPL/LP DAAC), via Microsoft Planetary Computer

low_spot_fraction.note: Cells >= 1 m below the mean within 150 m radius (300 m window), on the 150 m-smoothed DEM. NASADEM is whole metres, so treat as candidates.

water.source_note: surface vs groundwater use not looked up (BC water licences are not queried)

example_limit_af_ac.note: Example limit for trying the water-allocation control with a forage field. Not this field's allocation, licence or district delivery; replace it with the real number.

sgma_status.text: SGMA, water districts and CDEC reservoirs are California institutions; BC water licensing is not integrated.

water_context.watershed: Salmon River (Shuswap), lower reach; Bessette Creek is the other 2023 order area

orders.title: Fish population protection orders M0238_2023 (lower Salmon River) and M0239_2023 (Bessette Creek): about 398 licence holders to stop using water for forage crops
Temporary protection order issued for the Salmon River
Order rescinded as farmers and ranchers dealt with elevated wildfire risk (BC's wording)

New temporary protection order: 458 surface water and groundwater licences and transitioning groundwater users in the Salmon River watershed stop irrigating forage crops, lawns, fairways and gardens; effective 19 Aug 2026

water_context.note: No California-style water district or SGMA basin. Surface and groundwater licences are issued by the Province under the Water Sustainability Act; this field's licence is not looked up (the lookup would identify an owner).

cdl.reason: No USDA Cropland Data Layer in Canada; AAFC's Annual Crop Inventory is used instead (one Pasture / Forages class, no alfalfa class).

cdec.reason: SGMA, water districts and CDEC reservoirs are California institutions; BC water licensing is not integrated.

dwr_wells.reason: SGMA, water districts and CDEC reservoirs are California institutions; BC water licensing is not integrated.

usdm.reason: The coming-season outlooks (NOAA CPC, US Drought Monitor, CDEC) are US products; not built for BC.

rma.reason: USDA RMA crop-insurance records cover the United States only; BC Production Insurance loss data is not public at field or county level.

openet.reason: OpenET covers the western United States only; there is no field-scale measured water use for BC.

cimis.reason: CIMIS is California's station network; BC has two ECCC climate stations near this field (one closed in 2021).

nasa_datasets.name: NASA POWER daily weather
nasa_datasets.tells_you: Daily heat, cold, rain and the reference crop water demand (ETo) for your area.

nasa_datasets.name: GPM IMERG rainfall
nasa_datasets.tells_you: How much rain fell on your field each day, from NASA's satellite rain estimate.
nasa_datasets.note: Final run (gauge-adjusted) to its last day, Late run (satellite only) after that.

nasa_datasets.name: SMAP soil moisture (L4, root zone)
nasa_datasets.tells_you: How wet the soil is down to about 1 m compared with normal for this time of year.

nasa_datasets.name: SMAP soil moisture (L3, surface retrievals)
nasa_datasets.tells_you: The satellite's direct measurement of the top 5 cm of soil, on days it is reliable.
nasa_datasets.note: Retrievals over flooded rice or open water are flagged and dropped, not filled.

nasa_datasets.name: GRACE-FO groundwater
nasa_datasets.tells_you: Whether groundwater under your area is higher or lower than usual (percentile).
nasa_datasets.note: Model that assimilates GRACE/GRACE-FO gravity data; 2-3 month latency.

nasa_datasets.name: MODIS vegetation greenness (NDVI)
nasa_datasets.tells_you: How green the area is compared with the same two weeks in 2000-2025.

nasa_datasets.name: ECOSTRESS crop stress and water use
nasa_datasets.tells_you: Whether the crop is using as much water as it could (stress index) on days the space station passes over.

nasa_datasets.name: OPERA surface water (DSWx)
nasa_datasets.tells_you: When and how much of the field was under water (winter flooding, floods).
nasa_datasets.note: Not fetched for this field; GET /water_seen is estimated from the Sentinel-2/Landsat water masks instead.

nasa_datasets.name: HLS (Harmonized Landsat Sentinel-2)
nasa_datasets.tells_you: What is growing on the field and when it is bare, green or flooded, every 2-3 days.

nasa_datasets.name: Landsat 8/9 (NASA/USGS)
nasa_datasets.tells_you: Field greenness record used with Sentinel-2 in the main calendar.

nasa_datasets.name: NASADEM elevation
nasa_datasets.tells_you: Slope and low spots on and around the field.
nasa_datasets.note: Radar noise of 2-4 m on flat fields: slope uses a 150 m smoothed surface.

nasa_datasets.name: ISS astronaut photographs
nasa_datasets.tells_you: Photos of the area taken by astronauts on the International Space Station.
nasa_datasets.note: Image courtesy of the Earth Science and Remote Sensing Unit, NASA Johnson Space Center. Near the field, not of it.

crop_history_source.title: AAFC Annual Crop Inventory (ACI), 30 m (56 m 2009-2010)

data_gaps.reason: OpenET covers the western United States only; there is no field-scale measured water use for BC.
data_gaps.filled_with: Estimated from the rotation engine's FAO-56 crop ET for today's rotation on Salmon Arm station weather (/openet).

data_gaps.reason: CIMIS is California's station network; BC has two ECCC climate stations near this field (one closed in 2021).
data_gaps.filled_with: Estimated reference ET: FAO-56 Penman-Monteith on ECCC station temperatures in the engine; Hargreaves on POWER in daily.json.

data_gaps.reason: USDA RMA crop-insurance records cover the United States only; BC Production Insurance loss data is not public at field or county level.
data_gaps.filled_with: Estimated from Salmon Arm station history: summer drought, rain at haying, heat and frost years as peril shares (/insurance).

data_gaps.what: Water district, groundwater basin and reservoirs (SGMA, CDEC)
data_gaps.reason: SGMA, water districts and CDEC reservoirs are California institutions; BC water licensing is not integrated.
data_gaps.filled_with: BC water-order context (fish population protection orders, 2023 and 2026) as the reservoir_storage trend layer and the outlook's allocations_context.

data_gaps.reason: No USDA Cropland Data Layer in Canada; AAFC's Annual Crop Inventory is used instead (one Pasture / Forages class, no alfalfa class).
data_gaps.filled_with: AAFC Annual Crop Inventory crop history (one Pasture / Forages class).

data_gaps.reason: No field-scale soil API in BC like SSURGO; the AAFC Soil Landscapes of Canada v3.2 polygon (1:1,000,000) at the field is used instead, with ISRIC SoilGrids v2 (a 250 m global model) as the fallback.
data_gaps.filled_with: AAFC Soil Landscapes of Canada v3.2 (1:1,000,000 polygon): texture, available water, organic matter and drainage weighted over the polygon's soils; hydrologic group derived. ISRIC SoilGrids v2 (250 m model) if SLC is not cached.

data_gaps.what: Coming-season outlooks (NOAA CPC, US Drought Monitor, CDEC)
data_gaps.reason: The coming-season outlooks (NOAA CPC, US Drought Monitor, CDEC) are US products; not built for BC.
data_gaps.filled_with: Estimated from ECCC 1991-2020 station climatology (equal chances) and a station rain-percentile drought index (/outlook, usdm_d2_weeks).

data_gaps.reason: The machine-learning calendar and stress models were trained on California fields and were not run here.
data_gaps.filled_with: Estimated with rule-based detectors on the field's S2/Landsat series: two-class NDVI calendar, transitions and z-score stress weeks (/calendar_ml, /transitions, /stress, /models).

_notes.region: British Columbia field: CA-only layers are listed in data_gaps with what fills them; their API routes serve estimates in the California shape with _source 'estimate'.
_notes.water_and_market: No water district or SGMA basin in BC; water_context holds the watershed and the 2023 and 2026 orders (the 8 Aug 2026 rescission included, kind rescission). market_preference is not stated for this field (no_preference).
_notes.boundary: ParcelMap BC legal parcel (open parcel fabric) inside the Agricultural Land Reserve, clipped to AAFC Annual Crop Inventory Pasture / Forages pixels (class 122 in >= 9 of 11 mapped years)
_notes.crop_history: AAFC Annual Crop Inventory majority class per year (no alfalfa class)
_notes.stations: Two stations: Salmon Arm CS is the only active one within 25 km; Silver Creek (in the Salmon River valley) closed in Oct 2021. This is the 'sparse stations' gap: California fields average 3 NOAA stations plus CIMIS.
